periods.time: Semifinal day through Ikki's emergency surgery
periods.label: 修复会场并保护学生的世界时钟

status.current: repairs Stella's venue damage, protects spectators from Amane's rampage, and waits through Ikki's surgery

personality.summary: Tired but responsible; she complains about destructive students while still doing the work to keep them and spectators safe.

relationships.stella-vermillion: Repairs the enormous venue damage from Stella's semifinal and tells her to fight without holding back despite the workload.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Orders him to step back during Amane's rampage and later waits outside his surgery room.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Tries to keep her calm during Ikki's emergency and explains why time reversal cannot safely save him.
relationships.nene-saikyo: Friend/colleague whose commentary and orders support spectator protection.

periods.summary: Kurono is exhausted because Stella's Dragon Spirit and final slash wreck the arena, but she accepts that protecting and repairing the venue is the adult knights' duty. During Amane's post-match rampage she orders the knights to suppress him and protect the spectators, then reluctantly accepts Ikki's insistence on handling Amane because the stands need every defender. After Ikki collapses, Kurono checks the video and discovers that a death hand grazed his arm when he saved the referee. She explains that her time reversal cannot safely undo several minutes of damage to a human body, leaving Kiriko as the decisive hope.

key_events.summary: Restores and protects the venue after Stella's destructive semifinal.
Commands staff to protect spectators and suppress Amane.
Identifies how Ikki was grazed and why time reversal is not viable.
